name: Pocket Gamer

sources.title: Pocket Gamer Contact Us — reviews@pocketgamer.co.uk (send info + promo code/APK + assets), news@pocketgamer.co.uk, competitions@, advertising@; PR best-practices; embargoes honored until material is public

requirements: Mobile games only — Pocket Gamer covers iOS/Android/handheld games; a SaaS product does not fit
Reviews: email reviews@pocketgamer.co.uk with game info, a promo code (or APK for Android), and assets
Send codes BEFORE App Store launch — they prep reviews for launch day; don't ask whether they want one, just send it
Include trailers, screenshots, and relevant info; name-drop notable industry experience; prior coverage links help
Embargoes honored but considered void once material is public anywhere; reviews may publish the moment a game is live
Other desks: competitions@pocketgamer.co.uk (giveaways), advertising@pocketgamer.co.uk, individual writer contacts on the About page
preparation: A mobile game with a promo code or APK ready before launch
workflow: Email reviews@pocketgamer.co.uk with the game info + promo code/APK + assets ahead of launch
Alternatively submit trailers via the free 'SM Business Network' service mentioned on the contact page
Coverage is earned editorial — reviews, news, features — no listing page is created
watchFor: Hard vertical restriction — mobile games only; non-game SaaS is off-beat
They reserve the right to publish a review as soon as the game is publicly available
Embargo breaks by anyone = embargo void for that material
Steel Media network also runs PocketGamer.biz (B2B) and events — different contact surface for industry-facing pitches
countsAsLive: A Pocket Gamer review, news story, or feature covering the game is published at pocketgamer.com
unknowns: How the 'SM Business Network' trailer-submission service works in practice
